title: Bret Hart vs. Shawn Michaels: rivalry and Montreal
summary: The rivalry moves from a championship test of endurance to the disputed finish in Montreal. The latter involved a real disagreement, not merely a scripted submission.

chapters.title: Michaels wins in sudden-death overtime
chapters.result: Shawn Michaels defeats Bret Hart in the Iron Man title match.
chapters.context: A scoreless regulation period leads to overtime and Michaels’ championship win.

chapters.title: The Montreal finish
chapters.result: Michaels is awarded the title when the bell rings despite Hart not submitting.
chapters.context: The disputed finish accompanies Hart’s departure and feeds the later Mr. McMahon character.
